name: Fresh A/C

ad.headline: Odor Neutralizer
ad.description:
Specially formulated to remove foul, musty odors quickly and effectively from automobile air conditioning systems. It will freshen foul-smelling systems by killing odor-producing organisms. Powerful deodorizers keep the automobile interiors smelling fresh and clean.

By cleansing the system, problems such as breathing discomfort and eye irritations may be avoided when the occupant turns on the air conditioner. It is not just for A/C odors; it works equally well to control odors in the heating system during cold seasons.
benefits: Disinfectants, cleans, and deodorizes A/C Systems.
Easy to Use: No application tools needed.
